expectedOutcome: After completing the plan, learners understand a practical sequence for studying common data structures and algorithms and have a review framework they can continue to extend.
goal: Build algorithm-practice foundations through a Chinese-friendly learning sequence.
notRecommendedFor: Completed 150 questions and only dedicated breakthroughs
You have to interview a sprinter in two weeks.

phases.focus: Build foundations in array indexing, two pointers, prefix sums, and matrix traversal.
phases.title: Array and Matrix Foundations

phases.focus: Practice linked-list rewrites, fast/slow pointers, and deletion boundaries.
phases.title: Linked-List Pointer Operations

phases.focus: Use hash tables for counting, deduplication, set intersections, and two-sum relationships.
phases.title: Hashing and Set Modeling

phases.focus: Practice string processing, parenthesis matching, and basic stack/queue implementations.
phases.title: Strings, Stacks, and Queues

phases.focus: Systematically practice DFS/BFS traversal, tree height, paths, and binary search tree validation.
phases.title: Binary-Tree Traversal and Properties

phases.focus: Practice choosing, undoing choices, pruning, and grid search.
phases.title: Backtracking Search

phases.focus: Develop greedy intuition through local choices and interval boundaries.
phases.title: Greedy Algorithms and Intuition

phases.focus: Progress from one-dimensional states to knapsack and string DP, emphasizing state definitions and transition order.
phases.title: Introduction to Dynamic Programming

phases.focus: Complete foundations in grid BFS/DFS, graph construction, and connectivity.
phases.title: Graph Foundations and Final Review

prerequisites: Can write basic cycles and functions in one language
Willing to repeat errors and templates by week
recommendedFor: I don't know where to start.
Need a system boost in Chinese
I'd like to start with Easy/Medium.
summary: A 12-week beginner roadmap in Chinese that progresses through arrays, linked lists, hashing, strings, trees, backtracking, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, and graphs.
targetAudience: Beginner to early-intermediate learners who want to build a connected knowledge system through structured practice and prefer a Chinese learning roadmap.
title: 12-Week Algorithm Foundations Plan
